exposure: mode of birth (cesarean vs. normal delivery)
cohort: A total of 201 pregnant women who delivered at Semen Padang Hospital between January and December 2021 were included.
finding: Total direct costs did not differ significantly between the IFA and MMN groups, however, cesarean delivery costs were approximately 5 times higher than normal delivery costs.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery costs were approximately 5 times higher than normal delivery costs.
